title: Helm chart: `global.imageRegistry` (added in 2.11) removed again

detection.reason: Helm values are not collected; the running image is

remediation: Only a release installed at 2.11 can carry this value (it existed in 2.11 alone). If it set `global.imageRegistry` (for a mirror), set the full registry path in `image.repository`, `webhook.image.repository` and `certController.image.repository` before upgrading; 2.12 ignores `global.imageRegistry` and pulls from ghcr.io.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)(external-secrets/external-secrets|bitnami/external-secrets)([:@]|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | join(","))"'  # each row is an ESO workload and the registry it pulls from today
coversNotes: v2.12.0 (General): fix: Revert breaking change to change imageRegistry
chart value certController.image.repository default changed external-secrets/externa -> ghcr.io/external-secrets
chart value image.repository default changed external-secrets/externa -> ghcr.io/external-secrets
chart value webhook.image.repository default changed external-secrets/externa -> ghcr.io/external-secrets

title: Template function `fail` removed
remediation: Remove `fail` from the templates of the ExternalSecrets named; a template calling it no longer parses. ESO's function map has no `required` (that is Helm's): to abort rendering on bad input call a function that errors (e.g. `mustFromJson`), or drop the guard.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | (.spec.target.template // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template // {}) | tostring | select(test("fail ")) | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row's template may call fail
